title: 第21章 只惹大事第22章 志在必得
lines: 第21章只惹大事
旧货店里，盛夏从一厚本拍卖目录后面探出头，“老米，咱们手里有多少钱？现在。”
“我瞧瞧。”米丽伸手摸过手机，“两百三十多万……”
“差不多够了。”盛夏愉快的打断米丽的话，再次拎起目录看了眼，“最好提前看一眼，嗯，我去找周凯。”盛夏拎着那本目录，站起来往外走。
“什么好东西？”米丽伸长脖子，好奇无比的问了句。
“这么大一个碧玉莲。”盛夏掐着小指头冲米丽比划了下，出门去找周凯。
周凯没在，盛夏站在门口，纳闷了半天。
昨天周凯跟米丽去w酒吧长见识，喝酒喝到半夜才回，照周凯的习惯，今天肯定要睡到直接去她们家吃中午饭，可这会儿才十点出头，他去哪儿了？
盛夏慢吞吞往楼下走，下到一楼，迎面看到个一身黑衣的高大男子，仰头往上看了看，大步直冲上楼，黑衣男子带起的风从盛夏脸上扫过，盛夏抽了抽鼻子，这个人，好象有点人味儿不足。
盛夏甩着胳膊走到街对面的奶茶店，仔仔细细挑了份布丁椰果加珍珠的奶茶，奶茶做好，盛夏喝着奶茶，挪到旁边一家面包店里，挨个细看各式面包，蛋糕，甜品，每一样都细看了一遍，再一样一样看回去，才挑了奶油号角，迷你芝士派，千层牛奶面包三样，慢腾腾拿现金付好帐，拎着出来，才看到刚才的黑衣男子脚步飞快的下了楼，往和盛夏相反的方向大步走了。
盛夏拎着面包回到店里，将黑衣人的事和米丽说了，“……周凯是做贼的行家，有人进去过，他肯定能看出来，等他回来问问，真要是去了他那里，得把那个女鬼的事告诉他。”
“嗯，大约是看周凯平平安安住进去了，以为那女鬼已经烟消云散，去收那道符的。”米丽撇了撇嘴，又是一个人渣子……不一定是人……又是一个渣子。
“也有可能，是那女鬼找上门去了，过来看看怎么没能困住的。”盛夏撕着块牛奶面包咬着。
米丽再次撇嘴，还是渣子。
周凯中午没回来，吃了中午饭，盛夏去长风拍卖行交了保证金，离了好几米，隔着厚厚的防弹玻璃看了眼那些拍品，就回去了。
这一批拍品中有几件起拍价过千万的贵重东西，安保十分严格。
直到晚上九点多，周凯打电话让米丽给他开门，他在院门外呢。
米丽一路小跑开了门，周凯侧身挤进院子，“你们吃过饭了？还有吃的没有？我饿坏了。”
“这都几点了？你怎么还没吃饭？你回过家没有？”米丽边走边问，带着周凯直奔厨房。
盛夏从廊下的摇椅中坐起来，和老常一起跟进厨房。
“没什么事吧？”盛夏打量着看起来十分疲惫的周凯。
“没什么事。”周凯接过老常递过来的热茶，歪进椅子里，“有几个熟人，过去看了几眼，有什么吃的？先给我一口垫垫，饿的难受。”
“老常下午打了点年糕，我给你做碗年糕汤吧。”米丽说着话，已经开冰箱拿了些虾仁、瘦肉等出来，老常过去，接过虾仁和肉泡在水里，米丽拿了一小块火腿，开始切丁，老常拿了六七根菠菜细细的洗。
盛夏站起来，将上午买的那盒迷你芝士派递给周凯。
米丽切好火腿丁，再将瘦肉切成细长的肉丝，老常洗好菠菜，挑干净虾肠，米丽起油锅炒好肉丝虾仁火腿丁，倒了一碗高汤，抓了把年糕片放进去，片刻汤滚，将菠菜放进去，盛出来淋了几滴香醋，端给周凯。
周凯从米丽开始切火腿起，就咬着芝士派，眼里只有米丽和那只汤锅了。

Chapter 21 Only causes big trouble
In the thrift store, Shengxia poked her head out from behind a thick auction catalog, "Old Mi, how much money do we have in hand? Now."
"Let me see." Milly reached out and touched the phone, "More than 2.3 million..."
"That's almost enough." Shengxia happily interrupted Mi Li, picked up the catalog and took a look at it again, "It's better to take a look in advance, um, I'll go find Zhou Kai." Shengxia picked up the catalog, stood up and walked out.
"What good thing?" Milly stretched her neck and asked curiously.
"Such a big Jasper Lotus." Shengxia pinched her little finger and gestured to Mi Li before going out to find Zhou Kai.
Zhou Kai was not there, and Shengxia stood at the door, wondering for a long time.
Yesterday, Zhou Kai and Mi Li went to W Bar to get acquainted, and they drank until midnight before returning. According to Zhou Kai's habit, he would definitely sleep until going to their house for lunch today, but it was only early ten o'clock now, where was he?
Shengxia slowly walked downstairs, and when she got to the first floor, she saw a tall man in black. He looked up and strode straight upstairs. The wind brought by the man in black swept over Shengxia's face. Shengxia sniffed. This man seemed a little inhumane.
Shengxia walked to the milk tea shop across the street, swinging her arms, and carefully selected a milk tea with pudding, coconut, and pearls. The milk tea was ready. Shengxia drank the milk tea and moved to a bakery nearby. She looked at the various breads, cakes, and desserts one by one. She looked at each item carefully. , looked back at everything, and then picked three kinds of cream horns, mini cheese pie, and thousand-layer milk bread. He slowly paid the bill in cash and carried it out. Only then did he see the man in black walking quickly downstairs and striding in the opposite direction to Shengxia.
Shengxia returned to the store with the bread and told Milly about the man in black, "...Zhou Kai is an expert thief. If someone has been in, he will definitely be able to tell. When he comes back to ask, if he really goes to his place, he must tell him about the female ghost."
"Well, I guess I saw Zhou Kaiping settled in safely and thought that the female ghost had disappeared, so I went to collect the talisman." Mili curled her lips, another scumbag... not necessarily a human being... another scumbag.
"It's also possible that the female ghost came to the door and came to see why she wasn't trapped." Shengxia tore off a piece of milk bread and bit into it.
Millie pouted again, she was still a scumbag.
Zhou Kai did not come back at noon. After lunch, Shengxia went to Changfeng Auction House to pay the deposit. He stayed several meters away and looked at the lots through the thick bulletproof glass before returning.
There are several valuable items in this batch of auctions with starting prices exceeding 10 million, and security is very strict.
It wasn't until around nine o'clock in the evening that Zhou Kai called and asked Mi Li to open the door for him. He was outside the courtyard gate.
Mi Li ran all the way and opened the door. Zhou Kai squeezed into the yard sideways, "Have you eaten? Do you have anything to eat? I'm starving."
"What time is it? Why haven't you eaten yet? Have you been home?" Mili asked as she walked, leading Zhou Kai straight to the kitchen.
Shengxia sat up from the rocking chair on the porch and followed Lao Chang into the kitchen.
"Is everything okay?" Shengxia looked at Zhou Kai who looked very tired.
"Nothing's wrong." Zhou Kai took the hot tea handed over by Lao Chang and leaned into the chair. "I have a few acquaintances. I went over to take a look. What's there to eat? Give me a bite first. I'm so hungry."
"Old Chang made some rice cakes in the afternoon. Let me make you a bowl of rice cake soup." As she spoke, Mili opened the refrigerator and took out some shrimps and lean meat. Old Chang went over and took the shrimps and meat and soaked them in water. Mili took a small piece of ham and started dicing it. Old Chang took six or seven spinach and washed it carefully.
Shengxia stood up and handed the box of mini cheese pies he bought in the morning to Zhou Kai.
Mi Li cut the ham into cubes, and then cut the lean meat into long and thin shreds. Lao Chang washed the spinach and picked out the shrimp intestines. Mi Li stir-fried the shredded pork, shrimp, and diced ham. She poured a bowl of soup stock, put some rice cake slices in, boiled the soup for a while, put the spinach in, poured it out with a few drops of balsamic vinegar, and served it to Zhou Kai.
Zhou Kai started biting into the cheese pie from the moment Millie started cutting the ham, with only Millie and the soup pot in his eyes.
